tools.purpose: Verify a 64-byte Ed25519 signature against an embedded public key with a pure RFC 8032 implementation, or derive the public key and sign from a seed in memory.
tools.expect: verified/not-verified with the failing reason, plus the RFC 8032 vector table under --self-test

notes: Curve arithmetic is pure Python (RFC 8032 section 5.1); the three section 7.1 vectors reproduce byte-identical public keys and signatures. Seeds stay in memory: the tool never writes key material.
